newsitem.title: CROATIA: CROATIAN SELLS HRK57.8 MLN 182-DAY T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: CROATIAN SELLS HRK57.8 MLN 182-DAY T-BILLS.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said it sold 57.8 million kuna in 182-day treasury bills at a primary auction on Tuesday.
It had planned to raise 40 million, but bids overshot the target.
The issued price remained flat at 95.025 percent four weeks ago and so did the rate at 10.50 percent.
Full results on page MFHT will be delayed due to a technical fault.
Banking investors bought around 85 percent of the issue. Bills are payable in two days and mature on February 12, 1998.
Croatia has 569.1 million kuna in outstanding 42-, 91- and 182-day T-bills.
The ministry sets the next auction for August 19, when it will seek to raise 150 million through a new 42-day issue.
Foreigners have no direct access to the auction but can place their bids with Croatian banks. -- Davor Huic, Zagreb Newsroom, +385-1-4557-075
